＊Riko＊＠０９１＿００１Huh?＝＠０９１＿００２What are you staring at me for?￥We've never even met.￥How rude!＝＠０９１＿００３Hm...? Oh, you're one of the￥candidates. Sorry, I didn't￥really remember you!

Yeah, I know.
Sorry, I don't remember.
Yes, I know.
Sorry, I'm not sure.

＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０１２But to qualify, what you need￥first is "Judgment"!
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０１３You may not know this, but it's￥the most important skill for￥piloting the Elan Ship, okay?
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０１４No matter what else you can do,￥if you can't do this, you don't￥get on the ship!!
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０１５But why can't I remember￥much about you?＝＠０９１＿０１６I thought I'd checked out￥everyone at the top.
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０１７So what exactly are you good at?
Nothing in particular.
I'm good at everything.
Nothing in particular.
I'm good at everything.

＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０２３Besides, being full of yourself￥without the skills to back it up￥will ruin you someday, you know?
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０２４Honestly...＝＠０９１＿０２５You're a weird one. There's￥something about you that's￥beyond my common sense.
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０２７Listen. If you ever see me￥around the facility from now on,￥don't you dare talk to me!
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０２８I don't know about you, but I￥don't consider you a teammate.￥Not one bit!!
Same goes for me.
That's harsh.
Same goes for me.
That's so mean...
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０２９Oh my, well, isn't that nice!
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０３０I don't want to waste time on￥useless people either!
＊Riko＊＠０９１＿０３１It's not harsh! I'm just telling￥the truth, okay?
＊Riko＊...
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００１Aaah! Hey!￥Did you just look away from me?!＝＠０９２＿００２How rude!＝＠０９２＿００３Unbelievable! You're a disgrace￥to candidates everywhere!＝＠０９２＿００４Hear me out to the end!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００５I only want to spend time with￥people I've acknowledged.
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００６Even if you ask me to team up,￥there's absolutely NO way￥I'll go along with it!!
Relax, I won't ask.
What would it take?
Relax, I won't ask.
What would it take?
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００７Oh? Should you really be￥talking like that?
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００８When you get stuck in Judgment￥training, you'll regret saying￥that. But by then it's too late!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿００９There's no way I'd acknowledge￥you that easily!＝＠０９２＿０１０And figure that out yourself!!

＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０１５But they could at least pick￥people whose abilities￥aren't in doubt.
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０１６They tell us to compete and push￥each other, but with rivals like￥these, what's the point!
Yeah, it's hopeless.
Then quit and go home?
Yeah, it's hopeless.
Then quit and go home?
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０１７I'm talking about you!￥YOU!!＝＠０９２＿０１８Ugh, you're unbelievably dense!!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０１９Why should I go home?!￥If anyone goes home, it's you!
＊Kaname＊＠０９２＿０１１Rikooo!￥Let's go get something to eat!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０１２Coming, coming!￥Hang on a sec!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０２０You don't seem to quite get it,￥but...＝＠０９２＿０２１without any standout abilities,￥your chances of qualifying￥are pretty slim!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０２２In other words!!＝＠０９２＿０２３Unless you beat the top person￥in some field, your chances of￥going to Elan are zero!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０２４Not that you could pull that off￥right now even if you stood on￥your head!!
＊Riko＊＠０９２＿０２５Well, good luck with that.￥Bye!
